notes.en: 2f extra recovery on whiff; great ranged poke; Punish Counter knockdown gives great corner carry and can juggle into Cannon Spike in the corner (623MK is most consistent but can whiff at longer ranges); extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; crouch-sized hurtbox on frames 1-28; particularly vulnerable to Drive Impact in neutral; can anti-air some long range jump-ins; has high juggle potential (causes air reset when juggled into)

notes.en: Fires beacon into the air that spawns 3 downward-hitting Super-priority projectiles (these projectiles disappear if Ingrid is hit); button strength determines beacon position (Modern Controls: hold back/neutral/forward to control position); LP version appears in front of the opponent, MP version appears above the opponent, HP version appears behind the opponent (except at fullscreen distance); can hold the button to spend up to 2 Sun Crests for additional projectiles; projectile startup varies based on strength: LP 103f / MP 68f / HP 98f; gap between blocked projectiles is 8f / 7f (varies when switching between stand/crouch block, but always large enough to throw between projectiles); grounded opponents are put into a free juggle state by the 3rd projectile (1st/2nd keep the opponent grounded); airborne opponents are put into a free juggle state or maintain the existing juggle count; Ingrid cannot gain additional Super gauge while the projectiles are active or until the current combo ends; after SA2 activation, can combo after a Forward Throw (limited juggle) or Back Throw (free juggle)

notes.en: Spawns 2 portals in the air according to button strengths used (LP close, MP mid, HP far); while the portals are active, JP cannot use 214P command grab; portals disappear if JP is hit or thrown; can manually input 214LP/MP or 214HP follow-up while portals are active; if no follow-up is input, each portal automatically spawns a 1-hit OD spike projectile (starting with the closest portal) angled toward the opponent 70f after JP recovers (110f total startup); spikes put opponents into a free juggle state; the automatic spike activation allows for strong mixups, as JP is free to move while it occurs (unlike 214PP~214HP version where he snaps his fingers); cannot spawn another portal until both have disappeared; Juggle Increase value becomes 1 when connecting mid-combo against opponent in a Free Juggle state (ensures that opponent will have Juggle Count 1 after the spikes connect)

notes.en: Puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit (this occurs after the hitstop of the 1st hit ends, so it will be granted when Super canceled but not if it trades with opponent's attack); safe on block advancing special; last 2 hits only play out on hit and are not cancelable (listed recovery refers to the blocked version); 3f extra recovery on whiff; 4f extra recovery when absorbed by armor (guaranteed punish when absorbed by Drive Impact unless canceled into SA3); counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries through both hits (gives light confirms on CH and medium confirms on PC); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (follow-ups are usually only possible in the corner)
